data.title: 阿尼斯 · 体育馆只剩最后一拍
data.description: 队员还没进场，阿尼斯先把应援的末拍走了一遍。她踩在线内高举一个金色绒球，用另一只绒球指向节拍器。顶窗亮光扫过橙黄队服和百褶裙边，落在球鞋旁的白线。
data.action: 一手把金色绒球举过头顶，另一手用绒球指向边线的节拍器。
data.promptProse: At the edge of the empty gym court, she raises one pom-pom above her head and points the other toward a metronome by the sideline. Late light from the high windows reaches the white line under her leading foot.
data.animaCaption: One pom-pom is high above her head while the other points across the boundary line.
